unreadable.reason: Live copy is an Incapsula bot-protection page: HTML has only a robots noindex meta and an _Incapsula_Resource script with an empty body; the text file is blank apart from the source line.
Live copy is a Cloudflare challenge page ("Just a moment... Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue"); no alumni content.

notes: Chunk 2 has six pages, each with only a live copy read 2026-10-18 (no archived snapshots were provided in the chunk). HBS TOM: the page section is headed "Recent Placement" and each entry reads "Name, YEAR" followed by "Initial Placement: ...", "Update: ..." (later move), "Dissertation: ..." and "Advisors: ...". The page does not say whether the year is the graduation or the placement year, so yearMeaning is "unstated"; the integrator should decide whether HBS placement-page years are treated as graduation years. Degree "PhD" comes from the page-level sentence "Harvard Business School PhD graduates are in demand ...", not from a per-person label. Advisors are recorded only inside the note (the page lists them as advisors, not graduates). Yale SOM Operations: the "Recent Graduates" section gives "Name (YEAR) Initial Placement at X"; yearMeaning "graduation" from the heading. Akshaya Suresh (2024) has placement "TBA" as written. The "Current Students" section (10 names, not marked as job-market candidates) was skipped per the brief. Degree "PhD" is page-level (PhD program navigation), not per-person. CMU Tepper: the table "Initial Placements of Ph.D. Graduates" has an explicit "Graduation Year" column, so yearMeaning is "graduation"; program is the area heading of each table (Accounting, Behavioral Economics, Business Technologies, Economic & Public Policy, Economics, Financial Economics, Marketing, "Operations Mgmt. / Robotics", "Operations Research / ACO", Organizational Behavior). All areas were recorded; the integrator should filter to operations-relevant areas. Degree "Ph.D." is page-level from the table title. One 2026 Operations Mgmt. / Robotics row has an empty last-name cell ("Neha" only). Some hiring institutions carry "(post-doc)" in the cell; kept verbatim in destination. The "Current Candidates" section contains no names on this page. Typos on the page (e.g. "Freddice Mac", "Universtat Autonoma") are kept as written. KLU: the page lists no years at all (listedYear null for every row; the only years in the HTML are in image filenames). It shows each graduate with a current position and employer, which is NOT a first job and may be the latest known affiliation; both are copied as written. Honorifics are copied into degree ("Dr.", "PhD", "Prof. Dr.") and removed from name; names without a title get degree null. Two section headings matter: "Graduated at KLU" and "Graduated at external universities" (the latter are listed on KLU's PhD Graduates page but graduated elsewhere; recorded with the heading in note so the integrator can decide whether they belong to the KLU program). Four people are shown only as "Former KLU PhD Candidate, graduated" (Falk Freese, Kiran Busch, Elham Ahmadi, Robin Kabelitz-Bock); this looks like a placeholder, and the "Kühne Logistics University - KLU" employer line under Falk Freese may be a default rather than a job. "Dr. Thomas Fandrich" has no position or employer on the page. NUS and INSEAD live copies were bot walls (Incapsula script page with empty body; Cloudflare "Just a moment..." challenge) and yielded no records.
